Yes — that makes the exclusion feel explicit and safe. Choosing "Reading" in "Leave out a label" cleanly dropped the Reading link and left the other match, and the "Leaving out: Reading" note sitting under the search is the important part: it tells me plainly that something's being deliberately held back, so if I'm missing a link I half-expected, I can see straight away it's because I chose to exclude that topic — not because it's lost. That visible reminder of what I'm leaving out is exactly what keeps it from feeling like things are mysteriously vanishing.

That rounds out the deeper search nicely — narrowing within a label, exact phrases, "either/or," and now "leave this out," all in plain words with a clear note of whatever's active. Search does everything I hoped and stays understandable. Happy with it.
